roles.name: Reporting_Read
roles.description: See and download Reporting-Service reports (catalog requiredRole). Grants no M3 endpoints. grp-fin-manager is interim until it is nested into rpt-reader (ADR-013), then remove it.

roles.name: SupplyChain_Buyer
roles.description: Supply Chain Workbench: sees and edits (Category, Details) the lines of their own MOVEX buyer codes. Reporting-Service decides which lines those are. Grants no M3 endpoints. grp-sc-buyer is nested in pur-buyer (ADR-061).

roles.name: SupplyChain_Planner
roles.description: Supply Chain Workbench: sees every line and writes Planners Notes only. Grants no M3 endpoints. The AD group does not exist yet (ADR-061 amendment, 2026-11-05: to be requested from Manal, proposed name pur-planner); empty means nobody holds the role.

roles.name: SupplyChain_Manager
roles.description: Supply Chain Workbench: sees every line and edits Category and Details on all of them, including generic buyer codes. Grants no M3 endpoints. grp-sc-manager is nested in pur-manager (ADR-061).
